Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing the rights of crime victims.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to victims of crime; and adding a new section tochapter 7.69 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 7.69 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) At all criminal proceedings before a court, the presidingofficer shall inquire as to the presence of the victim and/or asurvivor of the victim and, whether the victim is present or not, shallread the following: "Victims of crime have rights under Washington law with the intentto ensure that all victims and witnesses of crime are treated withdignity, respect, courtesy, and sensitivity; and that the rights ofvictims, survivors of victims, and witnesses of crime are honored andprotected by law enforcement agencies, prosecutors, and judges in amanner no less vigorous than the protections afforded criminaldefendants. A flier with the complete list of victim rights isavailable outside this courtroom." p. 1 HB 1389 (2) The court shall make available fliers with a complete list ofvictims' rights outside the courtroom.
